title: What's Cooking in Business Central: Early Access Preview

chapters.title: Creating an EAP Environment from Admin Center

features.name: Early Access Preview Sandbox Environments
features.description: Ability to create sandbox environments running version 28.0 ahead of official release, allowing exploration and testing of latest Business Central features before general availability.
features.status_evidence_quote: we have just released version 27.0 of Business Central, but you can already get a look at version 280
caveats: Available only in USGB and DE regions
Updated weekly, not meant for production
Environments may be deleted without notice

features.name: EAP Environment Notification Bar
features.description: Display of a notification bar in early access preview environments to remind users this is a preview environment and provide navigation to documentation.

features.name: Feature Discovery Capabilities
features.description: Planned capability to easily discover new features inside early access preview environments and provide feedback.
features.status_evidence_quote: We are working on adding capabilities so that you can easily discover new features inside these environments

quotes.text: we have just released version 27.0 of Business Central, but you can already get a look at version 280
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the availability of early access preview for the next version before official release

quotes.text: We currently support creating these environments in USGB and DE
quotes.why_it_matters: Documents geographic limitations for early access preview environment creation

quotes.text: Make sure that you read the information in the message box and that you are aware of the preview terms before confirming
quotes.why_it_matters: Indicates users must explicitly accept preview terms when creating these environments

quotes.text: Now you will be able to explore and try out all the latest Business Central features before they are out on an official version
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes the core purpose and benefit of early access preview environments

quotes.text: A partner sandbox license is required for early access preview. We update these environments to newer builds weekly
quotes.why_it_matters: States key requirements and maintenance frequency for early access preview environments

quotes.text: these environments are not meant to be used for production uh because they may be deleted without notice
quotes.why_it_matters: Emphasizes the non-production nature and risk of data loss in preview environments

disclaimers.text: Make sure that you read the information in the message box and that you are aware of the preview terms
We display this notification bar to remind you that this is an early access preview environment
We are working on adding capabilities so that you can easily discover new features inside these environments
these environments are not meant to be used for production uh because they may be deleted without notice
